description: Human review package for Hokom-Saleh-Taaqol sentence corpus. All cases require human linguistic review before being promoted to GOLD status. This stub contains a 10-case sample (SCX-001 through SCX-010). The remaining cases follow the same schema.
review_instructions: For each case: (1) verify the Arabic surface text is a valid Arabic form; (2) confirm stage_expectations align with classical Arabic grammar rules; (3) check hokom_evidence provides accurate morphological/syntactic data; (4) set review_decision to 'APPROVED' or 'REJECTED' with notes; (5) set reviewer to your name and review_timestamp to ISO-8601 datetime.
sample_note: This file contains SCX-001 through SCX-010 as a representative sample. Full review of all 157 cases should use the same schema applied to each entry in hokom_saleh_taaqol_sentence_corpus_150.json.
